messages:
evan: Quick sync — we need a concrete proposal for the API metering fields + throttle policy for the next roadmap milestone. Customers are asking for per-route quotas and pricing-aligned fields for embeddings, rerank, and function calls. Can we have a draft by EOD Fri?

maya: Clarify scope: do we standardize on a single "billing unit" abstraction, or expose per-operation counters (prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/embedding_ops/rerank_ops)?

rajesh: My vote: token accounting remains primary for text ops (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens). For non-token ops (embeddings, rerank, tool calls) use explicit op counters + multipliers. Example: embeddings_units = ceil(dims / 1024) ; rerank_units = rank_count * reorder_multiplier.

claire: From billing side we need fields that map directly to SKUs and line-items. Proposed minimal set to emit with every response / usage event: `sku_id`, `charge_amount_micros`, `billing_unit`, `billing_units`, `pricing_tier`. Expose same in Console and ingest into billing pipeline.

ev: @claire good. Also we need per-route quota enforcement: route_id, quota_window_secs, quota_limit, quota_behavior (hard/soft). What should the API error look like on enforcement? 429 + structured body?

maya: 429 with structured body please — include `quota_name`, `quota_remaining`, `retry_after_secs` and `suggested_fallback` (route/model id). Example body:```
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "quota_name": "embeddings:per-customer-daily",
  "quota_remaining": 0,
  "retry_after_secs": 86400,
  "suggested_fallback": "embeddings-small-v2"
}
```

rajesh: Throttling fields we should support in the API layer: `rate_limit_per_minute`, `burst_tokens`, `priority_tier`. Runtime can enforce token-bucket. Also add `quota_behavior: [hard, soft_alert_then_throttle]`. Soft should emit warning header but allow degraded throughput.

claire: Launch criteria (must-haves): 1) Console shows per-route usage and per-SKU mapping; 2) Usage events contain sku_id + billing_units; 3) Runtime enforces route-level hard quotas and surfaces 429 payload; 4) Billing pipeline metric names defined and validated. Optional: UI quota override for enterprise.

maya: Backcompat: keep existing `usage` field for a few quarters; make new fields additive: `billing_units`, `sku_id`, `quota_id`. Add server header `X-Redwood-Quota: quota_name=..., remaining=..., retry_after=...` for quick debugging.

evan: Customer asks: EnterpriseCorp wanted per-customer hard quota on embeddings with alerting + webhook. We should offer `quota_alert_webhook` in enterprise config. Also needs audit logs for overrides.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout created for `metering/v1` schema to staging at 2026-03-20T14:32Z :rocket:

rajesh: Small proposal for metered metric names to feed billing: `metered.tokens.prompt`, `metered.tokens.completion`, `metered.ops.embedding`, `metered.ops.rerank`, `metered.ops.function_call`. Emit `billing_units` as integer and `charge_amount_micros` for raw cost.

claire: Agree. Also add `pricing_metadata` in usage event -> list of strings tags for ingestion (e.g., ["enterprise", "dedicated", "promo-2026-q1"]).

maya: UX/SDK notes: add client-side helpers to compute estimated billing_units (for embeddings dims -> units) and warning hooks for quota nearing. Default SDK should surface `quota_remaining` header.

evan: Ok I'll draft RFC with sample schema + migration plan. Action owners: @maya SDK + API schema, @rajesh runtime/enforcement, @claire billing mapping + pipeline, @evan write RFC and prioritize in next planning. Please comment inline on the RFC when I post. :thumbsup:
